text_block_list.text:
We're at the start of the Classic Triple
Crown
tour. Кинг Хало readies herself to
take on the first
challenge: the Satsuki
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She makes her way to the paddock and

exchanges a few words with fellow
competitor
Сэйун Скай.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Though seemingly relaxed on the
surface, it's
clear to Кинг Хало that Seiun
Sky is in perfect
condition for racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Not only does she need to beat Seiun
Sky, she
needs great results. Her thirst
for victory is
stronger than ever.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
